cases.name: Deborah McGee
cases.about: A coworker said, "Ms. McGee was truly a jewel and will be sorely missed. I enjoyed her as a co-worker at Alpha Christian School and as a church member and choir member at Mt. Carmel Ministries. She was always positive, encouraging, and full of life and laughter."
